answer_2.quote: We primarily utilize referencefree metrics to measure the consistency of model evaluations. We compute Fleiss's Kappa and intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) between the evaluation results obtained after swapping option ID tokens and option positions.

answer_3.quote: Within this paradigm, two common methods are pointwise and pairwise evaluations. In pairwise comparison, LLMs select the better answer between two options. ... We propose CalibraEval to mitigate the selection bias present in "LLMs-as-Judges".
